data_science.title: Preemptive LLM Unlearning against Forbidden Capability Acquisition via Gradient Sealing
data_science.why_trending: Addresses critical open-weight LLM security through preemptive unlearning to prevent capability acquisition during fine-tuning, highly relevant as open-source models proliferate.

data_science.title: RoPE at the End of Its Rope? Theory, Diagnosis, and Mitigation of Long-Context Failures
data_science.why_trending: Provides theoretical characterization of RoPE failures in long-context LLMs, directly addressing practical limits of current transformer scaling approaches.

data_science.title: GrammarRL: Effective Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
data_science.why_trending: Combines RL with grammar-constrained generation to improve semantic quality of LLM outputs, addressing practical deployment constraints.

data_science.title: Shared Weights, Selected Computations: How Looped Transformers Route What Each Loop Does
data_science.why_trending: Investigates weight-sharing mechanisms in looped transformers, revealing how shared parameters enable diverse computational behaviors for iterative reasoning.

data_science.title: What Limits Recursive Reasoning Models: Optimization, Architecture and Test-Time Scaling
data_science.why_trending: Systematically analyzes optimization and architectural factors limiting recursive reasoning models, clarifying design choices for compact algorithmic solvers.

finance.title: Dyson-Schwinger Effective-Action Methods for Rough Volatility: A Correlation-Response Architecture for Calibration, Exotics and Risk
finance.why_trending: Develops non-perturbative quantum field theory framework for stochastic volatility calibration, advancing rough-volatility modeling for exotic pricing.

finance.title: Say, Echo, Do: Strategic Narratives and Revealed Positioning in Financial Markets
finance.why_trending: Analyzes strategic narrative-trading interactions where institutions can talk down assets while accumulating positions, with quantified thresholds for narrative credibility.

finance.title: QuantCode Model: Specializing Language Models for Executable Algorithmic Trading Code
finance.why_trending: Demonstrates specialization of LLMs for executable algorithmic trading code, bridging natural-language strategy specification and framework-compliant implementation.

finance.title: Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Modeling for Stochastic Discount Factor Portfolios
finance.why_trending: Combines diffusion models with retrieval-augmented learning for SDF-based portfolio optimization, handling non-stationary regime shifts in financial data.

finance.title: A Generalized Langevin Model of Latent Liquidity and Concave Price Impact
finance.why_trending: Models market impact through generalized Langevin dynamics with latent liquidity, capturing technical analysis support/resistance via local-time mechanisms.

social_sciences.title: Imputation is all you need: double robustness, semiparametric efficiency, and automatic covariate balance for estimating the average treatment effect
social_sciences.why_trending: Reveals hidden dual-weighting structure in sieve-regression imputation, unifying causal inference theory and showing automatic covariate balance properties.

social_sciences.title: When One Leak Pays Forever: Context Binding and the Price of Deterring Collusion
social_sciences.why_trending: Game-theoretic analysis of MEV-prevention committee collusion in threshold encryption, quantifying how single breaches unlock persistent future vulnerabilities.

social_sciences.title: Are there asymmetries in euro area monetary policy transmission?
social_sciences.why_trending: Identifies sign asymmetry in ECB monetary transmission using Bayesian additive regression trees, finding tightening has predictable effects while easing does not.

social_sciences.title: The Capacity Cost of Informational Screening
social_sciences.why_trending: Mechanism-design analysis of information elicitation under capacity constraints, showing when screening reveals harmful uses alongside beneficial ones.

social_sciences.title: Debiased Inference for Bounding Wage Inequality with Many Controls
social_sciences.why_trending: Develops debiased machine-learning approach for partial identification with moment inequalities, applicable to wage discrimination and inequality studies.

topics.name: LLM Safety, Alignment, and Unlearning
topics.summary: Papers addressing security and control of open-weight LLMs through preemptive unlearning, persona removal, and password-modeling insights; critical for responsible deployment of foundation models.

topics.name: Foundation Model Theory and Long-Context LLMs
topics.summary: Theoretical and architectural analyses of transformer scaling limits, weight-sharing mechanisms, and recursive reasoning; addresses how recurrent and neural-operator designs enable efficient computation.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning for NLP and Constrained Generation
topics.summary: Uses RL to improve controllable and rule-aligned text generation under grammar, instruction, and safety constraints; spans diffusion planning for autonomous driving and retrosynthesis.

topics.name: Volatility Modeling and Calibration
topics.summary: Advances in stochastic and rough volatility calibration using quantum-field-theory methods, Knothe-Rosenblatt transport, and loss functions tailored to financial prediction economics.

topics.name: Market Microstructure, Narratives, and Information Asymmetry
topics.summary: Analyzes strategic information disclosure, narrative-trading interactions, firm repositioning in language-model space, and latent-liquidity activation; bridges text and market dynamics.

topics.name: AI and Machine Learning for Quantitative Trading
topics.summary: Applies deep learning, diffusion models, and kernel methods to algorithmic trading, portfolio optimization under SDF framework, and hedging with neural embeddings.

topics.name: Causal Inference and Partial Identification
topics.summary: Develops debiased ML approaches for treatment effects, wage inequality, and optimal transport-based partial identification under unobserved heterogeneity.

topics.name: Blockchain Economics, Game Theory, and Mechanism Design
topics.summary: Game-theoretic and mechanism-design analyses of MEV collusion, information screening, voting rules, school choice, and strategic behavior under incentive constraints.

topics.name: Monetary Policy, Nonlinear Dynamics, and Econometrics
topics.summary: Studies asymmetries in monetary transmission, discretionary policy under wage inequality, price stability via random matrix theory, and GMM in IV models.

topics.name: Decision-Focused Learning and Optimization
topics.summary: Examines Jacobian rank collapse in decision-focused learning, bond portfolio optimization with transaction costs, algorithmic recourse under competition, and checkpoint selection for domain generalization.
